currentCollection.note: Both pages state that the stone still stands inside 隆兴寺 in 正定, sheltered by a stele pavilion. Neither gives the pavilion's position within the complex.
currentCollection.noteZh: 两处页面均记此碑仍在正定隆兴寺内，置于碑亭中。均未给出碑亭在寺院中的位置。

review.note: Draft object record. The in-situ claim and the unsigned height dispute come from state and provincial pages read on 2026-11-18; the stone was not examined.
review.noteZh: 草稿实物记录。原址所在与高度分歧取自 2026-11-18 阅读的国家级、省级页面；未核对原石。

notes: The structured dimensions are empty on purpose: one page gives an overall height of 3.24 m, another a face of 1.56 × 0.89 m plus a 0.42 m heading, and the two do not reconcile.
The 1980s conservation work is described without an exact year, so no dated event is recorded.
The stone is recorded as in situ; it has not been moved to a museum.
notesZh: 结构化尺寸特意留空：一处给通高 3.24 米，另一处给碑阳 1.56 × 0.89 米、碑额 0.42 米，两者不能互相校合。
二十世纪八十年代的维修无确切年份，因此不记带年份的事件。
此碑按原址记录，未移入博物馆。
